2607.21970.title: TextSLIP: Text Self-Supervised CLIP for Medical Report Generation
2607.21970.paper_summary: Automating radiology report generation is important for improving reporting consistency and clinical workflows . While Contrastive Language--Image Pretraining (CLIP) has advanced medical vision language modeling, existing CLIP-style approaches may still provide insufficient fine-grained semantic supervision for complex report generation. Standard CLIP primarily optimizes cross-modal alignment, without explicitly structuring the textual embedding space that guides visual representation learning. To address this limitation, we propose TextSLIP, a general medical vision-language pretraining framework that augments CLIP with intra-modal text contrastive learning. By improving textual embedding discriminability through self-supervised augmented text pairs, TextSLIP is designed to provide finer-grained linguistic supervision to the visual encoder. As an initial validation, we pretrain TextSLIP on a curated dataset of 7 million brain MRI image-text pairs and fine-tune the pretrained visual encoder within a report generation architecture. In controlled comparisons with CLIP-style baselines, TextSLIP shows consistent improvements on report generation metrics. Ablation studies further suggest that text-side self-supervision contributes to the observed gains. These results indicate that text-level contrastive learning is a promising direction for improving medical visual-textual alignment, while broader validation across additional medical domains remains an important next step.
2607.21970.paper_summary_zh: 自動化放射科報告生成對於提高報告的一致性和臨床工作流程至關重要。雖然對比語言-圖像預訓練（CLIP）已經推進了醫學視覺語言建模，但現有的 CLIP 風格方法可能仍然無法為複雜報告生成提供足夠的細粒度語義監督。標準 CLIP 主要優化跨模態對齊，而未明確構建指導視覺表示學習的文本嵌入空間。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了 TextSLIP，一種通用的醫學視覺-語言預訓練框架，通過模態內文本對比學習來增強 CLIP。通過自監督增強的文本對來提高文本嵌入的可區分性，TextSLIP 的設計旨在為視覺編碼器提供更細粒度的語言監督。作為初步驗證，我們在一個精心策劃的 700 萬腦部 MRI 圖像-文本對數據集上預訓練了 TextSLIP，並在報告生成架構內微調了預訓練的視覺編碼器。在與 CLIP 風格基準的受控比較中，TextSLIP 在報告生成指標上顯示出一致的改進。消融研究進一步表明，文本側的自我監督對觀察到的增益有所貢獻。這些結果表明，文本級對比學習是一個有前途的方向，可以改善醫學視覺-文本對齊，而在其他醫學領域的更廣泛驗證仍然是一個重要的下一步。
